_doc: Whole citrus fruit → its fresh-juice record, with the juice yield from USDA's own portions (grams of juice a fruit yields ÷ that fruit's edible weight, the same fruit size on both sides). An ingredient marked `prep: juiced` whose whole-fruit record is listed here is re-pointed to the juice record by scripts/set-produce-prep.mjs, its grams scaled by the yield, so the strained-off pulp's fibre is not credited. Only pairs where USDA tabulates a fresh juice and a 'fruit yields' portion are listed; juiced apples, carrots, celery and ginger have no such pair and stay on the whole-food record (a validation warning flags them).
